bootstrap.coreutils: Bootstrap file utilities used only while rebuilding the base; replaced by the Onlynux coreutils root target.
bootstrap.gcc: Bootstrap image C compiler; replace with Onlynux recipe for self hosting.
bootstrap.glibc: Bootstrap C library; minimum runtime ABI set by the build image
bootstrap.grep: GNU grep used by gzip helper scripts
bootstrap.g++: Bootstrap C++ compiler needed by upstream configure checks
bootstrap.glibc-locales: Bootstrap locales used only while testing locale-sensitive packages
bootstrap.perl: Bootstrap Perl required by the upstream OpenSSL Configure script
bootstrap.bison: Bootstrap parser generator required by iproute2 release builds
bootstrap.flex: Bootstrap lexical scanner generator required by iproute2 release builds
bootstrap.autoconf: Bootstrap GNU Autoconf for upstream snapshots without generated configure
bootstrap.automake: Bootstrap GNU Automake for upstream snapshots without generated Makefiles
bootstrap.libtool: Bootstrap GNU Libtool for upstream autoreconf
bootstrap.lzip: Bootstrap lzip decompressor required only to unpack pristine IANA tzdb source archives
bootstrap.python3-cryptography: Bootstrap Python X.509 parser required only to convert Mozilla certdata into PEM certificates
bootstrap.gperf: Bootstrap perfect-hash generator required by the upstream systemd build
bootstrap.python3-jinja2: Bootstrap template renderer required to generate systemd build sources
bootstrap.python3-pefile: Bootstrap PE/COFF parser required by the upstream systemd hardware-ID test generator
bootstrap.python3: Bootstrap Python interpreter required by upstream glibc generators
bootstrap.linux-headers: Bootstrap Linux UAPI headers used to build the C library and kernel-facing userspace

gzip.review_reason: Build the upstream release with its INSTALL instructions. Do not import Gentoo's gzip-reference renaming, alternatives package, symlink patch, blocker or post-install phase. Bootstrap supplies GNU build tools; scripts require shell, grep and sed.

sed.review_reason: Upstream sed installed under its canonical name. Initial minimal feature profile disables ACL, NLS, xattr and SELinux using upstream options. Gentoo's gsed rename, branding and system symlink are not imported.

coreutils.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported. The upstream rm/deep-2 test reports an infrastructure ERROR under the locked-down container; the adapter accepts exactly that single ERROR and still rejects every FAIL or XPASS.
coreutils.check_command: make check || { rc=$?; test "$rc" -eq 2; test -f tests/test-suite.log; test "$(grep -c '^ERROR: tests/rm/deep-2' tests/test-suite.log)" -eq 1; test "$(grep -Ec '^(FAIL|XPASS):' tests/test-suite.log)" -eq 0; }

findutils.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported.

diffutils.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported.

grep.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported.

gawk.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported. The optional persistent-memory allocator is disabled because its upstream test crashes under the locked-down no-new-privileges build sandbox; ordinary awk functionality and the remaining upstream suite stay enabled. Locale-sensitive upstream tests run with generated en_US, fr_FR, ru_RU, ja_JP and he_IL UTF-8 locales.

which.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported. Upstream configure performs a C++ preprocessor sanity check, so the bootstrap C++ compiler is declared explicitly.

tar.review_reason: Vanilla upstream release using its standard configure, make, check and DESTDIR install flow. Gentoo metadata supplies pinned source provenance only; no Gentoo phases, patches, branding, alternatives or post-install hooks are imported.

ncurses.review_reason: Build the pristine ncurses 6.5 upstream release with shared wide-character libraries. Gentoo metadata is not used for phases or patches.

less.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream release with the standard configure and make flow. ncurses is an explicit Onlynux dependency; no Gentoo phases or patches are copied.

nano.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream release with UTF-8 and without translated message catalogs. ncurses is built as an Onlynux dependency; no Gentoo phases or patches are copied.

file.review_reason: Build pristine file 5.48 with optional compression and seccomp integrations disabled for the initial base closure. No Gentoo phases or patches are copied.

bash.review_reason: Build pristine GNU Bash 5.3 using the system allocator and Onlynux ncurses. Distribution patchsets, profiles and Gentoo install phases are not imported.

pam.review_reason: Build pristine Linux-PAM with Meson, explicitly disabling optional integrations not yet in the Onlynux base closure. Only upstream sources and build definitions are used.

dosfstools.review_reason: Build pristine dosfstools 4.2 using its released Autotools files and compatibility command symlinks. No Gentoo phases or patches are copied.

pciutils.check_command: make -s SHARED=yes ZLIB=no DNS=no HWDB=no lspci setpci
pciutils.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" PREFIX=/usr SBINDIR=/usr/bin SHARED=yes ZLIB=no DNS=no HWDB=no install install-lib
pciutils.review_reason: Build pristine pciutils with its upstream Makefile. Optional zlib, DNS and systemd-hwdb integrations are disabled until their complete Onlynux closures are available.

ethtool.review_reason: Build pristine ethtool with the ioctl interface; optional netlink support is disabled until libmnl is packaged outside the fixed base set.

traceroute.review_reason: Build pristine traceroute 2.1.5 using its upstream Makefile. No Gentoo phases, patches or distribution service files are imported.

man-pages.review_reason: Install the pristine upstream Linux man-pages collection. Gentoo-specific pages, removals and overrides are intentionally not imported.

openssl.review_reason: Build pristine OpenSSL 3.5 LTS with its upstream Configure, test and install targets. No Gentoo patches or phases are copied.

kbd.review_reason: Build pristine kbd 2.10.0 with its released Autotools files. Optional compression libraries, PAM vlock, XKB and translations remain disabled until their independent Onlynux closures are present.

kmod.review_reason: Build pristine kmod 34.2 with upstream Meson and the core module-management tools. Optional compression and PKCS#7 integrations are disabled pending their complete independent closures; no OpenRC material is imported.

procps-ng.review_reason: Build pristine procps-ng 4.0.6 with ncurses. Optional SELinux and libsystemd integration are deferred until their libraries are independently available; no Gentoo patchset or phase is copied.

scdoc.review_reason: Independent build-tool dependency for kmod man pages, built from pristine upstream source with its Makefile. It is not added to the fixed Onlynux base set.

e2fsprogs.review_reason: Build pristine e2fsprogs against the independently packaged canonical util-linux libuuid and libblkid, avoiding duplicate libraries and utilities. Install upstream systemd units and udev rules; no Gentoo patches, OpenRC files or phases are imported.

iproute2.configure_command:
./configure --libbpf_force off && printf "TC_CONFIG_ATM := n
TC_CONFIG_XT := n
TC_CONFIG_NO_XT := y
HAVE_BERKELEY_DB := n
HAVE_CAP := n
HAVE_MNL := n
HAVE_ELF := n
HAVE_RPC := n
HAVE_SELINUX := n
" >> config.mk
iproute2.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" PREFIX=/usr LIBDIR=/usr/lib SBINDIR=/usr/bin CONFDIR=/etc/iproute2 DOCDIR=/usr/share/doc/iproute2 MANDIR=/usr/share/man ARPDDIR=/var/lib/arpd install
iproute2.review_reason: Build pristine iproute2 with upstream configure and Makefiles. Optional libmnl, libbpf, ELF, capabilities, iptables, RPC, Berkeley DB and SELinux integrations are explicitly disabled until packaged independently. The upstream testsuite-only generator unconditionally links libmnl, so the no-libmnl profile validates the built ip, tc and ss executables directly.

iputils.review_reason: Build pristine iputils ping, arping and tracepath without optional capabilities, IDN or gettext libraries. Privilege metadata will be assigned by the image policy; upstream systemd unit directory remains canonical.

f2fs-tools.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream snapshot after generating its standard Autotools files. UUID and block-device probing are supplied by the independently built util-linux libuuid and full libblkid; optional LZ4, LZO and SELinux integrations are disabled.

acpid.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install && mkdir -p "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" && printf "%s\n" "[Unit]" "Description=ACPI event daemon" "After=systemd-udevd.service" "" "[Service]" "ExecStart=/usr/sbin/acpid --foreground --netlink" "Restart=on-failure" "" "[Install]" "WantedBy=multi-user.target" > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/acpid.service"
acpid.review_reason: Build pristine acpid and add an Onlynux-native systemd service. No Gentoo patches, OpenRC scripts, event handlers or packaging phases are imported.

util-linux.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream util-linux release, including its canonical libblkid, libuuid, libmount, libfdisk and libsmartcols libraries. Optional host-specific integrations are disabled. The open_tree configure cache is forced off because bootstrap headers lack matching openat2 constants. Package staging suppresses privileged chown and set-ID mode changes, which are forbidden by the locked-down no-new-privileges builder; every selected program and library remains in the payload, with privilege policy left to Onlynux system configuration.

libxcrypt.review_reason: Independent runtime dependency for shadow, built with the pristine upstream Autotools flow from Gentoo pinned source material. No Gentoo phases or patches are imported. Generic crypt(3) API pages remain owned by the dedicated man-pages package, so only duplicate crypt*.3 files are omitted from this payload.

shadow.review_reason: Build pristine shadow account-management utilities against Onlynux PAM and independently packaged libxcrypt. Staging uses ordinary 0755 modes because set-ID transitions are forbidden in the no-new-privileges builder; final privilege policy belongs to Onlynux system configuration. shadow owns the account tools, while their duplicates are disabled in util-linux. No Gentoo phases, patches or OpenRC files are imported.

tzdata.build_command: make -j"$jobs" CC=gcc CFLAGS='-O2 -std=gnu99 -DHAVE_GETTEXT=0 -DZIC_BLOAT_DEFAULT=\"fat\"' REDO=posix_only TOPDIR= ZICDIR=/usr/bin
tzdata.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" CC=gcc REDO=posix_only TOPDIR= ZICDIR=/usr/bin LIBDIR=/nukeit install && rm -rf "$pkgdir/nukeit" "$pkgdir/etc" && rm -f "$pkgdir"/usr/share/man/man5/tzfile.5* "$pkgdir"/usr/share/man/man8/tzselect.8* "$pkgdir"/usr/share/man/man8/zdump.8* "$pkgdir"/usr/share/man/man8/zic.8*
tzdata.review_reason: Build pristine IANA tzdb with fat TZif output for broad compatibility, using the upstream Makefile and full offline test suite. Duplicate API manuals remain owned by man-pages; no Gentoo phases, patches or post-install timezone mutation are imported.

libmd.review_reason: Build pristine upstream libmd as the BSD digest compatibility library required by networking tools. No Gentoo phases, patches or distribution service files are imported.

dhcpcd.license: BSD-2 AND BSD AND ISC AND MIT
dhcpcd.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install && install -d "$pkgdir/var/lib/dhcpcd" "$pkgdir/var/empty" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d" && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=DHCP client daemon' 'Wants=network.target' 'Before=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=notify' 'ExecStart=/usr/sbin/dhcpcd --quiet --nobackground' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/dhcpcd.service" && printf '%s\n' 'u dhcpcd - "dhcpcd privilege separation" /var/empty /usr/sbin/nologin' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d/dhcpcd.conf"
dhcpcd.review_reason: Build pristine upstream dhcpcd with privilege separation and IPv6, without OpenRC or Gentoo patches. Onlynux supplies a native systemd unit and sysusers declaration; udev integration is deferred until the systemd package provides libudev.

libnl.review_reason: Build pristine upstream libnl libraries needed by nl80211 clients, without Gentoo patches, Python bindings or optional CLI utilities. The upstream test target is retained; tests requiring the optional Check framework are omitted by upstream configure when unavailable.

wireless-regdb.package_command: install -Dm644 regulatory.db "$pkgdir/usr/lib/firmware/regulatory.db" && install -Dm644 regulatory.db.p7s "$pkgdir/usr/lib/firmware/regulatory.db.p7s" && install -Dm644 regulatory.bin.5 "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man5/regulatory.bin.5" && printf '%s\n' '.so man5/regulatory.bin.5' > "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man5/regulatory.db.5" && install -Dm644 README "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/wireless-regdb/README" && install -Dm644 db.txt "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/wireless-regdb/db.txt"
wireless-regdb.review_reason: Install the pristine, upstream-signed regulatory database without rebuilding it, which would invalidate its signature. Firmware data uses the usrmerged /usr/lib/firmware location owned by Onlynux filesystem policy.

iw.review_reason: Build pristine upstream iw against the independently packaged libnl and ship the signed wireless regulatory database as a separate runtime dependency. No Gentoo phase, patch or distribution wrapper is imported.

zlib.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream shared zlib implementation and run its upstream test target. Static archives and Gentoo patches are not imported.

sudo.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" INSTALL_OWNER= install && rm -rf "$pkgdir/run" && find "$pkgdir" -name '*.la' -delete && install -Dm644 /dev/null "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sudo" && printf '%s\n' 'auth include system-auth' 'account include system-auth' 'session include system-auth' > "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sudo" && cp "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sudo" "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sudo-i"
sudo.review_reason: Build pristine upstream sudo with PAM, OpenSSL and system zlib. LDAP, SSSD, SELinux and legacy authentication plugins are disabled until their independent Onlynux stacks exist. Onlynux provides minimal PAM include files and explicitly restores and verifies the root-owned setuid mode after unprivileged staging; no Gentoo phases or patches are imported.

openssh.check_command: SUDO= SSH_SK_PROVIDER= TEST_SSH_UNSAFE_PERMISSIONS=1 make -j1 compat-tests interop-tests file-tests unit </dev/null
openssh.package_command:
make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install-nokeys && install -Dm755 contrib/ssh-copy-id "$pkgdir/usr/bin/ssh-copy-id" && install -Dm644 contrib/ssh-copy-id.1 "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man1/ssh-copy-id.1" && install -Dm644 /dev/null "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sshd" && printf '%s
' 'auth include system-auth' 'account include system-auth' 'session include system-auth' > "$pkgdir/etc/pam.d/sshd" && install -d "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d" "$pkgdir/var/empty" && printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=OpenSSH server daemon' 'After=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -A' 'ExecStart=/usr/sbin/sshd -D' 'ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID' 'KillMode=process' 'Restart=on-failure' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/sshd.service" && printf '%s
' 'u sshd - "OpenSSH privilege separation" /var/empty /usr/sbin/nologin' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d/openssh.conf" && printf '%s
' 'd /run/sshd 0755 root root -' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/openssh.conf"
openssh.review_reason: Build pristine OpenSSH portable with PAM, OpenSSL and system zlib, run the upstream non-root-compatible regression and unit-test subset, and install no host keys into the image. Onlynux supplies a native systemd service, sysusers identity and tmpfiles runtime directory; no Gentoo patches or OpenRC files are imported.

expat.review_reason: Build the pristine Expat release as a shared library with its standard CMake tests and tools. Gentoo supplies pinned source provenance only; no ebuild phases or patches are imported.

dbus.package_command:
DESTDIR="$pkgdir" meson install -C _build && install -d "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d" "$pkgdir/var/lib/dbus" && printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=D-Bus System Message Bus' 'Requires=dbus.socket' 'After=sysinit.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/dbus-daemon --system --address=systemd: --nofork --nopidfile --systemd-activation' 'ExecReload=/usr/bin/dbus-send --print-reply --system --type=method_call --dest=org.freedesktop.DBus / org.freedesktop.DBus.ReloadConfig' 'OOMScoreAdjust=-900' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/dbus.service" && printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=D-Bus System Message Bus Socket' '' '[Socket]' 'ListenStream=/run/dbus/system_bus_socket' 'SocketMode=0666' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=sockets.target' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/dbus.socket" && printf '%s
' 'u messagebus - "D-Bus system message bus" /run/dbus /usr/sbin/nologin' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d/dbus.conf" && printf '%s
' 'd /run/dbus 0755 messagebus messagebus -' 'd /var/lib/dbus 0755 messagebus messagebus -' 'L /var/lib/dbus/machine-id - - - - /etc/machine-id' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/dbus.conf"
dbus.review_reason: Build pristine D-Bus with the upstream Meson flow, daemon, tools and core tests; optional GLib-based modular tests are disabled to keep the offline base closure free of a non-runtime dependency. The library intentionally has no libsystemd dependency to avoid a bootstrap cycle; Onlynux supplies native systemd socket/service units plus sysusers and tmpfiles metadata, with no OpenRC files or Gentoo patches.

wpa_supplicant.package_command:
install -Dm755 wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant "$pkgdir/usr/sbin/wpa_supplicant" && install -Dm755 wpa_supplicant/wpa_cli "$pkgdir/usr/bin/wpa_cli" && install -Dm755 wpa_supplicant/wpa_passphrase "$pkgdir/usr/bin/wpa_passphrase" && install -Dm644 wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf" && install -d "$pkgdir/etc/wpa_supplicant" "$pkgdir/etc/dbus-1/system.d" "$pkgdir/usr/share/dbus-1/system-services" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d" "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man5" "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man8" && install -m644 wpa_supplicant/dbus/dbus-wpa_supplicant.conf "$pkgdir/etc/dbus-1/system.d/wpa_supplicant.conf" && install -m644 wpa_supplicant/dbus/fi.w1.wpa_supplicant1.service "$pkgdir/usr/share/dbus-1/system-services/" && install -m644 wpa_supplicant/doc/docbook/wpa_supplicant.conf.5 "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man5/" && install -m644 wpa_supplicant/doc/docbook/wpa_cli.8 wpa_supplicant/doc/docbook/wpa_passphrase.8 wpa_supplicant/doc/docbook/wpa_supplicant.8 "$pkgdir/usr/share/man/man8/" && printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=WPA supplicant' 'Before=network.target' 'Wants=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=dbus' 'BusName=fi.w1.wpa_supplicant1' 'ExecStart=/usr/sbin/wpa_supplicant -u -s -O /run/wpa_supplicant' 'Restart=on-failure' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' 'Alias=dbus-fi.w1.wpa_supplicant1.service' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant.service" && printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=WPA supplicant for %I' 'Before=network.target' 'Wants=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'ExecStart=/usr/sbin/wpa_supplicant -c/etc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant-%I.conf -i%I' 'Restart=on-failure' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant@.service" && sed 's# -i%I# -Dnl80211 -i%I#' "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant@.service" > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant-nl80211@.service" && sed 's# -i%I# -Dwired -i%I#' "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant@.service" > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/wpa_supplicant-wired@.service" && printf '%s
' 'd /run/wpa_supplicant 0755 root root -' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/wpa_supplicant.conf"
wpa_supplicant.review_reason: Build pristine wpa_supplicant with Linux nl80211, modern WPA3, AP/P2P/mesh, common EAP methods, OpenSSL and D-Bus. Onlynux supplies /usr-merged native systemd units and tmpfiles metadata; deprecated WEP/TKIP, Gentoo source edits and OpenRC files are not imported.

btrfs-progs.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream Btrfs utilities and shared library with the built-in checksum implementation. Optional conversion, Python, documentation, LZO, Zstd and libudev integration stay disabled until those independent stacks are part of the verified base; no Gentoo phases, patches, OpenRC files or distribution branding are imported.

linux-firmware.package_command: ./copy-firmware.sh -v -j1 "$pkgdir/usr/lib/firmware" && install -Dm644 README.md "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/linux-firmware/README.md" && install -Dm644 WHENCE "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/linux-firmware/WHENCE" && cp -a LICENSES "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/linux-firmware/" && find "$pkgdir/usr/lib/firmware" -xtype l -delete && test -n "$(find "$pkgdir/usr/lib/firmware" -type f -print -quit)"
linux-firmware.review_reason: Install the complete pristine upstream firmware snapshot into the usr-merged /usr/lib/firmware hierarchy using upstream copy-firmware.sh. Preserve WHENCE and the full per-file license collection, remove only broken symlinks, and perform no compression, deduplication, initramfs mutation, Gentoo patching or package-manager hooks.

systemd.license: GPL-2.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND MIT AND LicenseRef-Public-Domain
systemd.check_command: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib ./_build/systemd --version | grep -F 'systemd 261' && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib ./_build/systemctl --version | grep -F 'systemd 261' && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib ./_build/udevadm --version | grep -Fx '261' && meson test -C _build --list | grep -q .

systemd.review_reason: Build pristine upstream systemd as the Onlynux init, service manager, journal, udev, logind, networkd, resolved, timesyncd, tmpfiles and sysusers stack. Enable integrations already present in the verified base and disable optional policy/security, container/image and compression stacks whose independent dependencies are not yet in base. Preserve native upstream units and /usr-merged paths; import no Gentoo patches, branding, phases, OpenRC compatibility or integration package.

libusb.review_reason: Build the pristine shared libusb library with native systemd/libudev device discovery. Static archives, debug logging, hardware-dependent test binaries and Gentoo patches/phases are not imported; the upstream make check target remains enabled for the configured library.

usbutils.review_reason: Build pristine upstream lsusb and usbhid-dump against Onlynux libusb and systemd's native libudev. Keep the safe C utilities and usb-devices script; omit the optional Python frontend and deliberately unsafe usbreset executable, exactly as upstream leaves usbreset uninstalled. No Gentoo phases or patches are imported.

do echo "$entry" >> "$pkgdir/etc/group"; done; echo 'root:!:1::::::' > "$pkgdir/etc/shadow"; echo 'nobody:!:1::::::' >> "$pkgdir/etc/shadow"; echo 'root:!::' > "$pkgdir/etc/gshadow"; echo 'nobody:!::' >> "$pkgdir/etc/gshadow"; onlynux-filesystem.review_reason: Use the pinned upstream baselayout Makefile only to seed a standard hierarchy, then define an independent Onlynux usr-merged filesystem and identity policy. /bin and /sbin point into /usr, /usr/sbin remains a real directory, /lib and /lib64 point to /usr/lib, systemd NSS ordering and runtime directories are native, and no Gentoo branding, env.d, OpenRC scripts, device nodes, ebuild phases or post-install hooks are imported.

glibc.review_reason: Build the pristine GNU C Library release out of tree against a private complete copy of the declared Linux UAPI boundary, with modern hardening, multi-arch dispatch and an upstream subsystem test set. The runtime loader and shared libraries live in /usr/lib for the Onlynux usr-merged layout; tzselect, zic, zdump and compiled zoneinfo are deliberately owned by the separate tzdata recipe. The sole allowlisted test result is elf/tst-shstk-legacy-1g, whose CET shadow-stack outcome depends on GitHub runner CPU and hypervisor exposure; any additional FAIL remains fatal. Gentoo patchsets, multilib bootstrap archives, branding, ebuild phases, nscd and distribution integration are not imported.
